request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, cello, flute, piano, timpani, majestic and hopeful mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jeremiah waits in the guard court alone
The word of the Lord breaks the heavy stone
A message is sent to Ebed-melech
For the Cushite man who holds his breath

[Pre-Chorus]
The city faces disaster and not good
The words will pass before his eyes in the flood

[Chorus]
But I will rescue you on that day
You will not be handed over in fear
I will surely deliver you away
You will escape with your life, I swear

[Verse]
The men you dread will not take you down
Your trust in me has saved the crown
You have trusted in me, declares the Lord
A life preserved by the mighty word

[Chorus]
But I will rescue you on that day
You will not be handed over in fear
I will surely deliver you away
You will escape with your life, I swear

[Bridge]
The sword shall not fall, the doom is gone
The promise stands like the rising sun

[Chorus]
But I will rescue you on that day
You will not be handed over in fear
I will surely deliver you away
You will escape with your life, I swear

[Outro]
Because you have trusted in me
